product.name: Monoprice Split Plate with Flexible Opening Black
product.description: Keep your low‑voltage cable runs looking neat and tidy using this Split Plate with Flexible Opening from Monoprice™!This low‑voltage wall plate features a flexible opening, which allows you to neatly route up to six (6) low‑voltage signal cables through your wall. The split design means that you can install the plate around an existing cable run without having to disconnect or rerun the cables. The wall plate requires the use of a single‑gang, low‑voltage mounting bracket (available separately).Features: Low profile design fits behind the industry's thinnest mounts and TVsVirtually seamless designConceal multiple low voltage cables behind your flat panel TVEasily holds up to 6 cablesFlexible opening helps keeps low‑voltage pass‑though area coveredPerfect for eliminating connections at the wallAvailable in 4 colors: black, ivory, lite almond, whiteQuick and easy to installMounts to any standard low voltage mounting ring, old work ring, or mud ringNote that for safety purposes, you must use cable rated for in‑wall, riser, or plenum use when running cables inside your wall. Failure to do so could result in a fire hazard and invalidate any fire insurance claims.
